scope_note: Read-only audit of existing predictions; no model/API rerun. Paper text scope is abnormal videos and anomaly classes; VadCLIP public default code includes Normal.
limitations: Paper text and VadCLIP public default class/video scope conflict.
Ex-VAD author evaluation implementation not verified.
Project native-frame interpolation and official 16-frame repeat/feature-length support differ.
UCF CBT caps are documented as derived from test-set GT duration statistics; this is test-label-informed hyperparameter tuning.
Different models, pretraining and inference compute; no matched-compute reproduction.
XD frame AP has 799 actual predictions, while temporal metrics retain all abnormal GT.

clarification_current_public_code.xd_test: excludeNormal=False; all test inputs; range(0,7) includes Normal
clarification_current_public_code.ucf_test: excludeNormal=False; all test inputs; range(0,14) includes Normal
clarification_current_public_code.published_table_provenance: Paper states abnormal-only temporal mAP, but current public default code includes Normal. Exact code/config used for published table has not been established; do not assert its table is definitely 6/13-class abnormal-only.
clarification_current_public_code.frame_AP: Computed over concatenated full-test binary frame labels; Normal videos are negative examples. excludeNormal affects the separate temporal metric call, not frame AP.
clarification_current_public_code.true_flag_bug: Current loops remain hardcoded 7/14 and GT is not synchronously filtered when excludeNormal=True; changing only the flag is not a reliable abnormal-only evaluator.
